sources.entry: Developing iOS Apps with SwiftUI (Stanford CS193p) (video)

summary.title: CS193p - Developing Apps for iOS
summary.one_liner: Stanford's Spring 2025 CS193p course gives video lectures and supporting material for learning iOS app development with SwiftUI, covering Views, data flow, animation, SwiftData and basic multithreading.
takeaways: Lecture-by-lecture video index for Stanford's Spring 2025 CS193p iOS course
Covers SwiftUI basics: Views, layout, and data flow between Model and UI
Covers Swift type system topics such as generics and protocols
Builds a CodeBreaker app with animation, iPad support, sheets, and SwiftData persistence
The course predates iOS 26 and Xcode 26; the page notes the code is mostly compatible but no support is offered
summary.summary: This page is the landing page for the Spring 2025 offering of Stanford's CS193p, a course on developing iOS applications with SwiftUI. It lists video lectures with short descriptions, grouped into topics such as getting started with SwiftUI, Model and UI separation, layout and data flow, generics and animation, protocols, iPad and sheets, SwiftData, and multithreading. The lectures build a CodeBreaker app as the running example. The page also notes that the course was recorded before iOS 26 and Xcode 26, that the code is mostly compatible, and that no support is provided.
